inclusion_rationale: Published experimental benchmark of Dmai dsRNase-2 (330 nt, Dalaison-Fuentes et al. 2023): it is listed in the reference set for comparison, is evaluated with the same criteria and never counts as a recommended candidate.
limitations: Reference set only, never a recommended candidate. The sequence and its mapping are verified from the supplement and the reference, but the experimental protocols and the Results 3.4 endpoints are PROJECT_PROVIDED_NOT_AGENT_VERIFIED. The oral co-feeding design also delivers BicC dsRNA, so its endpoints are not attributable to this fragment alone and no efficacy score is derived. The fragment contains the defined synonymous variant at CDS 816, which falls in the forward primer site and does not match GITV01012450.1 exactly.

inclusion_rationale: Representative of the contiguous equivalence cell D2C-L400-006 (windows 351-416), tied at the top of ordering group 1 of the 400 nt ranking stratum: zero clipped specificity vector against DSRNASE1, DSRNASE3 and BICC, no intercepted known variable site, and a versioned APPROVED OTHER_TRANSCRIPT review decision (2026-10-07T00:00:00Z).
limitations: Multiple short OTHER_TRANSCRIPT HSPs are concentrated around CDS 500-540. No long or exact 19/21-nt match was detected; biological relevance remains unresolved.
